# Discoflare

> Open-source, self-hosted team chat for channels, threads, files, agents, tasks, and optional voice huddles, running in the workspace owner's Cloudflare account.

Discoflare is MIT-licensed software. Each deployment creates one workspace without a separate origin server. The workspace owner controls the deployment, configuration, and data. Cloudflare infrastructure usage is billed separately by Cloudflare.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://discoflare.com/index.md): Concise product capabilities, architecture, deployment, and availability information.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/vnmtvlv/discoflare): Source code, software documentation, license, and issue tracking.

## Documentation

- [Discoflare documentation](https://discoflare.com/docs): Guided and manual Cloudflare deployment, configuration, verification, backups, and upgrades.
- [Architecture source](https://github.com/vnmtvlv/discoflare/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Runtime topology, Cloudflare services, data ownership, and request flows.
- [Deployment source](https://github.com/vnmtvlv/discoflare/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): Maintainer-level deployment details and release procedures.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://discoflare.com/privacy.md): How the Discoflare marketing site handles information.
- [Terms of use](https://discoflare.com/terms.md): Terms governing use of the Discoflare marketing site.

## Optional

- [Human-readable website](https://discoflare.com/): The canonical Discoflare product website.
- [Public sandbox](https://sandbox.discoflare.com): A hosted workspace for trying Discoflare before deploying it.
- [Deploy with GitHub](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/vnmtvlv/discoflare): Source-based deployment that requires manual Cloudflare resource and account configuration.
